political_basis.subject: Shutdown interruption of SNAP in McLennan County
political_basis.real_hook: On November 4, 2025, KWBU reported over 31,000 McLennan County residents lacked November SNAP access during the shutdown; half payments were announced, but arrival remained unclear.
